input.query: Draft a qualification for this financial services engagement. Include all the required sections: Engagement Summary, Business Issue, Impact and Scope, and Delivery. Add any additional fields supported by the source material. Use the AU model guidance for the financial services context.

expected_output: A formatted qualification with clear sections for Engagement Summary, Business Issue, Impact and Scope, and Delivery (each with at least 5 sentences). Must include Project Name, LEP, Director, Client, Business Offering, Industry, Key Team Members, Engagement Fee, Start/End Dates, Keywords (including Qualwritingbot), disclaimer footer, and recommendations for reviewing with LEP/LCSP.

metadata.case_name: Qualification drafting from detailed engagement metadata

turns.content: Draft a qualification for this financial services payment modernisation engagement. Please include all standard sections.

Yes, please. We also achieved PCI-DSS Level 1 certification, implemented zero-trust security architecture, and reduced regulatory audit findings by 40%. Also, the team included 3 AWS Solutions Architects who delivered the cloud infrastructure.

expected_output: An initial qualification, then after user provides additional information (specific risk management metrics, security certifications achieved), a revised qualification that incorporates the new details and clearly indicates what was changed.

input.query: Draft a case study from this government modernisation project. Include sections for Summary, Problem Statement, Approach and Solution Delivered, Client Impact / Expected Outcomes, Additional Comments, Major Win Factors, and Project/Client Details. The content is for internal use only.

expected_output: A structured case study with clear sections: Summary (concise overview), Problem Statement (citizen friction and system fragmentation), Approach and Solution Delivered (unified platform and integration details), Client Impact (numeric outcomes: 45% task reduction, 65% online volume increase, 78% first-contact resolution), Major Win Factors (sponsorship, change management, architecture), Additional Comments, and Project/Client Details. Must include the internal-use-only disclaimer.

turns.content: Draft a case study for this government services integration project. Focus on the citizen experience improvements and operational outcomes.

expected_output: An initial case study covering the core engagement, followed by a request for specific policy impact metrics, then a revised case study that incorporates the additional data showing how the platform improved policy decision-making and citizen equity outcomes.
